description: Message quoting lets Wynem show the contents of any Discord message, straight in chat. Whenever someone sends a link to a message from the same server, Wynem automatically quotes the linked message so nobody has to jump between channels to see what is being talked about.

data.description: What's the best texture pack to use?

description: The Jump button takes you to the original message. The bin button deletes the quote, and can be pressed by the person who sent the link, anyone with the `Manage Messages` permission, or the server's moderators.
A single message can contain up to `10` message links, and each one will be quoted.
Quotes show as much of the original message as possible:

rows: The message's text is shown as the quote's description
The first image attachment is shown in the quote. Image links and Tenor gifs inside the message are shown too
Non image attachments are linked in an `Attached file` field
The names of any stickers are listed in a field
Any embeds on the message are displayed below the quote
Anything extra, like additional attachments or forwarded messages, is counted in an `Additional content` field
Linking a forum post quotes the post's starter message, with the post's title shown as the quote's title

description: Messages from NSFW channels are never quoted into non NSFW channels, and only links to messages from the same server are quoted automatically.

tabs.name: Automatic quoting
content: Automatic quoting is enabled by default, so there is nothing to set up. Whenever a message contains a link to a message from the same server, Wynem will quote it.
To get a message's link, right click the message (or long press on mobile) and select `Copy Message Link`, then send it in chat.

tabs.name: The quotemessage command
content: To quote a message manually, use the <command:quotemessage [messageURL]|server quote message-url:[messageURL]> command with the message's link. You can also reply to a message with the prefix command to quote the message you replied to, without needing a link at all.

For example: e!quotemessage https://discord.com/channels/731714469840551958/731714470314377247/1090728442059771904/server quote message-url:https://discord.com/channels/731714469840551958/731714470314377247/1090728442059771904

content: If the link is not a valid message link, or the message could not be quoted, you will get an error instead.

tabs.name: The Apps context menu
content: Wynem also has a context menu command for quoting messages, so you can quote a message without copying its link or typing a command.
Right click any message (or long press on mobile), then open the `Apps` submenu and select `Quote Message`. Wynem will quote the selected message.

content: The context menu command also works with Wynem's user install, letting you quote messages even in servers that do not have Wynem in them.

tabs.name: Toggling automatic quoting
content: If you would rather Wynem did not quote every message link, automatic quoting can be turned off with the <command:togglequotes|botconfig toggle quotes> command. This requires the `Manage Server` permission.

data.title: Quotes disabled
data.description: I will no longer quote message links in this server

content: Running the command again turns automatic quoting back on.

data.title: Quotes enabled
data.description: I will now quote message links in this server

content: The <command:quotemessage [messageURL]|server quote message-url:[messageURL]> command and the `Quote Message` context menu command keep working even while automatic quoting is disabled.
